svg.title: A collector that fans out
svg.desc: resolve runs once on S with all items and prints the files to fetch. BuildKit fetches every file and checks it against its sha256. The files go into up to 64 buckets by their key. each runs once per bucket, on S, the buckets side by side, and the output of each is a layer of its own. The buckets are checked against each other: a file in two of them stops the build. Otherwise they are merged onto S. then runs once on the result, with all files, and finishes the collector.
